recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty urban composition featuring an abstracted architectural structure rendered through a coarse halftone dot pattern in red and blue against a deep black background, anchored by bold, centered white typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast red halftone dots against a black void
Geometric architectural repetition versus organic dot texture
Bold white sans-serif text as a clean focal point against a busy background
Subtle blue accents breaking the red-black dominance
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone dot texture across all imagery
Limited color palette of red, black, white, and minimal blue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Abstracted building facade occupies the top two-thirds of the frame, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, centered white display text in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal lines of the building downwards to the central text, then to the smaller metadata text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black 'void' space between halftone dots and at the very bottom.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (typography) and Cobalt Blue (sparse halftone highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and blue against absolute black; maximum value contrast with white text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus on clean, industrial legibility
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy condensed display and light extended metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, industrial, condensed feel of the display text.
Matches the wide, modern feel of the bottom metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white image of a brutalist apartment block from a low angle. Apply a coarse halftone dot filter. Colorize the highlights with vibrant red and add sparse blue dots in the midtones. Ensure the bottom 20% of the image is mostly solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold, condensed white sans-serif font, centered in the lower third. Add a secondary line of text at the very bottom in a small, wide-tracked, extended white sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern coarse and visible?
Is the color palette strictly red, black, white, and blue?
Is the main text perfectly centered and legible?
Does the background feel urban and architectural?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of red to blue dots
Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Do not use the exact wording from the original image
Ensure the halftone effect is digitally generated rather than scanned from a specific source
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed outside the halftone dots
Ensure the red is vibrant and not muddy
Confirm the architectural subject is sufficiently abstracted
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Brutalism + Coarse Halftone + Red/Black Palette + Industrial Condensed Typography
